note:
⛔ SNG-447. THE PROPOSED RESTRUCTURE — 14 primary traditions on 7 axes, absorbing all 24 wheel poles as sects. Erik's demotions and absorptions, plus his rulings: Abstract joins Mind with Logic as 'different approaches or schools'; Violence pairs with Destruction and Creation with Peace; the pole name inverts to ORDER so Chaos keeps its antipode.
⚠️ COVERAGE VERIFIED: 24 of 24 poles, no duplicates, no orphans. The wheel survives at 14 poles, p ↔ p+7.

Mind.why: ⛔ THE ONLY THREE-SECT TRADITION AND THE ONLY ONE HOLDING THREE SOURCES. Thought reached directly (psychic), thought as ordered process (proof), thought as the wild leap (abstraction). ⚠️ Its secondaries ARE its other sects — nothing borrowed from outside.

Body.why: Ki as the primary, worked matter as the second. ⚠️ A Mason reading a load path and a Somatic reading a body are the same act on different material.

Light.why: ⛔ Light shaped through crystal, and truth seen without an instrument. Both are REVELATION — one burns it out of a place, one says it.

Dark.why: ⛔ EXACT MIRROR OF LIGHT, and deliberately. The Umbrals work the buried lattice in the deeps; the Veilwrights work the pure metaphysical form. ⚠️ Both are NOT BEING SEEN.

Life.why: ⚠️ Wild nanite as growth. Metaphysical second because green-heart work reaches something that is not in the soil — and because the Rootkin BREAK ORDERED DOWN as they go.

Death.why: ⛔ The mercy of stopping needs no apparatus; grief is tidal and ungoverned. ⚠️ Both handle the ending — one tends it, one mourns it.

Angelic.why: ⛔ ORDERED NANITE PRIMARY — mercy administered is machinery. PRECURSOR SECOND because the Seraphim are the human end of an argument the Precursors started, and the apparatus is an imitation of something older.

Demonic.why: ⛔ PRECURSOR PRIMARY — they draw on the alien source directly, being the other half of that disagreement. ⚠️ METAPHYSICAL SECOND IS THE LOAD-BEARING ONE: what Lucifer fell to wanting was the Veil thinned, and the Thinnings are the apparatus. THE DEMONIC INTEREST IN METAPHYSICS IS NOT SCHOLARLY.

Breaking.why: ⛔ Ki for the blow, crystal for the demolition. ⚠️ Violence and destruction are one impulse at two scales — people and things — and the old violence↔peace / destruction↔creation were the same argument drawn twice.

Building.why: ⛔ Crystal-assisted making, and held stillness. ⚠️ Both are about WHAT ENDURES — one raises it, one keeps it from being knocked down.

Chaos.why: ⚠️ Wild nanite, definitionally. Metaphysical second for the luck-riding — ⛔ and because the Churnfolk BREAK ORDERED DOWN, which makes them Order's actual enemy rather than its opposite number.

Order.why: ⛔ THE ONLY TRADITION WHOSE SECTS SHARE A SOURCE. Precursor second is precise, not decorative: LATTICEWORK IS HUMANS USING ORDERED NANITES TO REPRODUCE WHAT THE PRECURSOR SUBSTRATE IS AND DOES. The Lattice-Cities are an act of homage to something that has never answered them.

Span.why: ⛔ THE WAYGATES AND THE ARCHIVES THAT RUN FORWARD are both Precursor works. ⚠️ Ordered nanite second for the clock-towers — an hourkeeper's instruments are made, and a horizon-walker's roads are maintained.

Spirit.why: ⛔ Meaning without matter. PRECURSOR SECOND AND IT IS THE TRADITION'S WHOLE PROBLEM: they need MEANING-dense ground to work on, and the meaning-densest places in the world are Precursor sites — so they live at substrate 0.82, permanently obstructed by the ground they must stand on to find anything.

_balance._note:
⛔ PRIMARY: metaphysical 5 · precursor 5 · wild 2 · ordered 2. ⚠️ SECONDARY: metaphysical 6 · precursor 5 · ordered 3 · wild 2.
⛔ METAPHYSICAL IS THE MOST COMMON SECONDARY AND THE JOINT-MOST COMMON PRIMARY, WHICH IS A DESIGN DECISION AND SHOULD BE DELIBERATE. It reads correct to me: metaphysics is INNATE, so it is the source anyone can fall back on when the ground is wrong. ⚠️ It is also what makes the two-thirds substrate-dependent majority survivable — a precursor-primary tradition with a metaphysical secondary is weakened off-lattice, not helpless.
⚠️ ORDERED IS THE THINNEST at 2 primary. That may be right — ordered nanite is the newest and most human of the four — but Erik should see it stated.
